item.title: December 1.0 (97)
item.description:
## What's new
- **The directory tree no longer freezes.** Expanding a folder with thousands of subfolders used to block the window for about half a second; 5 000 folders now open in roughly 8 ms. Show hidden and refresh use the same path, so they move too. - **The tree keeps its place.** Turning Show hidden off keeps the folders you had open, and if the selected folder disappears the selection moves to its parent instead of pointing at a row that is no longer there. - **Watched downloads, and ⌘J.** December notices when a browser drops a file into a watched folder and rings one toast per burst; ⌘J jumps to the newest download in the active pane. Settings ▸ General ▸ Downloads starts with ~/Downloads and accepts extra folders — a second browser, a NAS, an external drive. - **The opposite pane's terminal opens in that pane's folder**, not wherever the terminal last was. - **The Inspector toggle sits in the title bar** and collapses the panel for real, so the file list gets the width back. - **iCloud Drive documents go to the Trash properly**, through the provider that owns them, instead of failing with "you don't have permission".
